caption: The worked example in five steps: four FP32 weights become four INT8 codes, then turn back into real values. Notice the INT8 codes, the small largest error 0.0016, and the 4× storage drop.

spec.title: Quantizing four weights to INT8 (z = 0)
spec.aria: A downward flow from the four FP32 weights minus 0.9, 0.1, 0.7 and 0.0, to scale s equal to 0.9 divided by 127, to integer codes minus 127, 14, 99 and 0, back to dequantized values, to a largest error of 0.0016, and finally to storage falling from 128 bits to 32 bits, 4 times smaller.
